group_bridge.local_klein: the selected A4 has a unique normal K ~= Z2 x Z2
group_bridge.identification: D6*/D6 ~= K, unique as an abstract group up to automorphism of K

exact_repackaging.equation: End(V4)|_K = R_K (gravity) + R_K (1+3 electroweak) + 2 R_K (3'+5 color)

interpretation.Sym2_dimension_10: 4 trivial + 2 of each nontrivial K character
interpretation.Sym2_0_dimension_9: 3 trivial + 2 of each nontrivial K character
interpretation.Lambda2_dimension_6: 2 of each nontrivial K character, no trivial mode

naive_four_forces_equal_four_characters_.statement: No 4-dimensional K representation induces an End(V) character decomposition with dimensions 4,1,3,8.
naive_four_forces_equal_four_characters_.consequence: The four sheets do not label the four forces one-to-one. The force split is the A5 recombination of quadratic/cross-sheet transfer modes.
